ruleDefinitions.name: Potential Excel.EXE DCOM Lateral Movement Via ActivateMicrosoftApp
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects suspicious child processes of Excel which could be an indicator of lateral movement leveraging the "ActivateMicrosoftApp" Excel DCOM object.

sequences.query: (parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\excel\\\.exe$") AND ((process_original_file_name = "foxprow\.exe" OR process_original_file_name = "schdplus\.exe" OR process_original_file_name = "winproj\.exe") OR (process_path = RGX("\\\\foxprow\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\schdplus\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\winproj\\\.exe$"))))
